steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('.hud, #hud, .hud-root').forEach(e => e.style.display = 'none'); const A = window.__app; A.settings.quality = 'ultra'; A.settings.rayTracing = false; A.view.applySettings(A.settings); window.__q = (q, rt) => { A.settings.quality = q; A.settings.rayTracing = !!rt; A.view.applySettings(A.settings); return q; }; window.__dbg = (o) => { window.__postDebug = o; A.view.postKey = ''; A.view.applySettings(A.settings); return JSON.stringify(o); }; window.__sun = () => { const s = A.view.sky.sunDir; return Math.atan2(s.x, -s.z) * 180 / Math.PI; }; window.__forest = (r, near) => { const W = A.session.world, T = W.trees; let best = -1, bn = 0; for (let i = 0; i < T.count; i += 5) { if (Math.hypot(T.x[i], T.z[i]) > (near ?? 1e9)) continue; let n = 0; for (let j = 0; j < T.count; j += 2) { const dx = T.x[j] - T.x[i], dz = T.z[j] - T.z[i]; if (dx * dx + dz * dz < r * r) n++; } if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = i; } } return [T.x[best], T.z[best], bn]; }; window.__fc = (x, z, agl, back, pitch, dh, clr) => { const CL = clr ?? 10; const W = A.session.world, T = W.trees; const hd = __sun() + (dh ?? 0); const a = hd * Math.PI / 180; const ux = Math.sin(a), uz = -Math.cos(a); let cx = x - ux * back, cz = z - uz * back; for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { let ok = true; for (let i = 0; i < T.count; i++) { const dx = T.x[i] - cx, dz = T.z[i] - cz; if (dx * dx + dz * dz < CL * CL) { ok = false; break; } } if (ok) break; cx -= ux * 6; cz -= uz * 6; } const y = W.terrain.heightAt(cx, cz) + agl; A.debugTeleport(cx, y, cz, hd, 0); A.debugLook(0, pitch); return [Math.round(cx), Math.round(y), Math.round(cz), Math.round(hd)]; }; return __sun(); })()
